text:
rachel_am: Silverline AI (acct SL-404) opened a ticket about INV-2026-06. They see an unexpected prorated reserved line that looks like it duplicates part of their monthly commit during our scheduled maintenance window. Posting the invoice excerpt they attached.

rachel_am: Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-06 | SL-404 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $11,000.00
INV-2026-06 | SL-404-maint | Reserved Prorated (06/18 01:00-01:30) | $1,650.00  <-- they say this shouldn't exist
INV-2026-06 | SL-404 | Burst (06/18 01:15-01:20) | $210.00
```

rachel_am: Customer insists the maintenance was within their committed window and that prorated reserved charges are double billing. Can ops confirm what happened?

tim_ops: Running allocator and maintenance logs now. Quick findings: our maintenance automation marked the dedicated pool as "maintenance-hold" at 01:00 and created a temporary maintenance-tag pool `sl:maint-20260618`. The proration job treats new tags as separate buckets, so it emitted a prorated reserved line against the maintenance tag while the parent commit was still active. Metering shows total tokens consumed remain within the monthly commit.

tim_ops: `billingctl inspect --acct SL-404 --window 2026-06-18T00:50-01:40` output (abridged):
```
2026-06-18T00:59Z maintenance:hold applied -> pool=reserved-SL-404 tags=[sl:prod, sl:maint-20260618]
2026-06-18T01:02Z proration:run -> created prorate record for tag=sl:maint-20260618 amount=15% ($1,650)
2026-06-18T01:30Z maintenance:complete -> tags reconciled
```

tim_ops: TL;DR: bookkeeping produced a prorate line for the maintenance tag despite no additional token consumption. Root cause: proration job doesn't coalesce maintenance-tagged traffic back into parent commit when hold is short-lived.

olga_billing: Proposed customer-facing remediation:
- Remove prorated reserved line: credit $1,650
- Apply SLA credit for the maintenance-caused spike: per contract this tier gets 4% per qualifying incident; 4% of $11,000 = $440
- Waive the small burst fee $210 as goodwill
Provisional total = $2,300.

pablo_fin: I can provisionally approve up to $2,400 to close quickly. Create FIN-8002 to track the provisional credit. Finance requires an infra backfill ticket and a short RCA blurb saved to the credit record.

rachel_am: Draft reply to customer: "Thank you — we found that our maintenance orchestration created a temporary maintenance tag which led to a duplicate prorated reserved line. We've applied a provisional credit of $2,300 and will issue a corrected invoice after we run a backfill. This is a one-time correction and will not change your committed profile going forward. ETA for final invoice: 48 business hours." Good to send?

olga_billing: Send it. I'll BCC legal. Logging FIN-8002 now.

zara_infra: Opening INFRA-55100 to patch proration coalescing for short maintenance holds and run a backfill for SL-404 (06/18 window). Action items:
- Update proration job to treat maintenance tags under 2 hours as part of parent commit when token counts are within commit limits.
- Re-run allocation backfill for 2026-06-18 and stage corrected invoice in S3.
- Add a nightly validation check to flag maintenance-tag prorates for review.

zara_infra: ETA for patch + backfill: 36 hours. INFRA-55100 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-55100

billing-bot: Metering alert: `maintenance-prorate-flag` SL-404 2026-06-18T01:02Z. Candidate orphan prorate detected.

pablo_fin: FIN-8002 created and provisionally approved. Finance will finalize after INFRA-55100 backfill and AM confirmation. Please include a one-paragraph RCA in the customer-facing note when finalizing.

rachel_am: Customer acknowledged provisional credit and asked for corrected invoice when ready. I'll update thread on backfill completion.

zara_infra: Backfill complete: 2026-06-19T07:45Z. Results: regenerated allocations remove the maintenance prorate line. Corrected invoice staged at s3://redwood-billing/corrections/SL-404/INV-2026-06-corrected.pdf

billing-bot: FIN action: credit_applied FIN-8002 amount=2300 recipient=SL-404 timestamp=2050020000

pablo_fin: Verified backfill and applied the credit. Final invoice issued and uploaded. Closing FIN-8002.

rachel_am: Customer confirmed receipt and is satisfied. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
